thread:
sara_sales: GreenPeak returned the RFI + security questionnaire. They want a Private VPC POC, dedicated pricing options, and a filled capability matrix. Dropping the draft RFI and CSV here. Need SOC2 answers and retention policy confirmed before I upload to their portal. @mike_se @aj_engineer please advise.

olivia_solns: On it. I'll update the capability_matrix and the RFI answers. Quick Q: is the POC expected to use customer-managed VPC peering or our VPC with strict ingress rules?

mike_se: They specified customer-managed VPC peering. For the POC we can offer VPC-lite with ephemeral volumes and 30d audit log retention. HSM integration is available but needs approvals.

aj_engineer: Confirm we can do 30d retention + HSM for POC, but infra lead time is ~10 business days. Also recommend we model cost using quantized-lite-2 to keep estimates realistic.

olivia_solns: I'll mark Q4 (key management) as HSM-supported and Q7 (audit logs) as 30d retention in the draft. Adding notes about no persistent customer data on the POC instances.

sara_sales: Customer asked for committed monthly pricing tiers and a one-off POC setup charge. Draft pricing (for discussion):

```
Tier,MonthlyCommit,POCSetup
Dedicated-4GPU,$19,200,$11,500
Dedicated-8GPU,$36,000,$11,500
Private-VPC-Small,$23,500,$14,000
```

mike_se: Looks fine. Add this footnote: "POC pricing assumes 30-day evaluation, no production SLA, and CPU fallback when GPU capacity constrained." CPU fallback typically reduces cost estimate ~15-20% but increases latency.

aj_engineer: Agree. Also call out that model variants will be routed on latency policy; include an example: "primary: model-x-large, fallback: model-x-cpu-quant" in the RFI capability matrix.

sec_q_bot: Security template applied to RFI. See applied answers for encryption_at_rest and key_rotation. Reminder: upload /attachments/audit_retention_v2.pdf and /templates/sec_answers/hsm_integration.md.

olivia_solns: I've attached capability_matrix_greenpeak.csv and redwood_rfi_greenpeak_v2.pdf here. I'll remove any wording implying production SLAs in the POC answers.

sara_sales: GreenPeak wants to kick off week of Apr 15. Can we hit that? Need calendar invites and a short success criteria doc for the POC (latency SLO, throughput target, sample prompts).

aj_engineer: Apr 15 is tight given infra lead time. Recommend Apr 22 kickoff. I'll prepare the infra checklist and send invites when infra is greenlit.

mike_se: I'll prep a one-page security cover for the portal upload with contact points for escalation: mike_se + aj_engineer.

olivia_solns: I'll include a short paragraph in the RFI about graceful degradation and routing policies. Also adding the pricing footnotes (CPU fallback, quantization assumptions).

sara_sales: Perfect. Once olivia updates the PDF I will upload to the customer's RFP portal. Please confirm when the audit policy PDF is in attachments so I can reference it.

sec_q_bot: Uploaded: /attachments/audit_retention_v2.pdf. Also scan result flagged access_logging=enabled, rotation=30d.

aj_engineer: Noted. I'll set calendar for Apr 22 and add POC success criteria.

sara_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll wait for the final PDF then push to portal. :thumbsup:
